346512.なんと キュララナビーチで\nムーロンとメローラの 結婚式が\n執りおこなわれた:
Muron and Melora's wedding is to take place
at Kyurarana Beach! How nice!

346513.まぶしく輝く 太陽の下で \nふたりは 永遠の愛を誓い\n新しく生まれた夫婦を:
Under the sparkling sun, the two exchanged
their vows of eternal love. Everyone cheered
and celebrated the newlyweds.

346515.「……水温よし。しびれくらげ なし。\n サメバーンの姿も……見えないな。:
Good temperature...
and not a Man o' War in sight...
No Sharkburns either.

346516.「ムーロンさん。問題なさそうっス！: Looks like we're good to go, Muron!

346517.「まどろっこしいのは ナシだぜ。\n スリルとロマンスの夏は 唐突に始まる……。:
No need to beat around the bush.
A summer of thrills and romance is
waiting...

346519.「この夏 最大の青春が\n 大グチ開けて 待ってるってなぁ！:
The greatest summer of your young lives
is just around the corner!

346520.「よぉーっし！ お前たち！\n 準備体操は 終わっているか！？\n お待ちかねの:
Yeeeah! Hey, everyone! Are y'all ready? The
water is officially opened!!

346521.「サイッコーの ながめだぜ……。\n やっぱり キュララナビーチの夏は 格別だな:
What an amazing view...
Nothing beats the summers at this beach.

346522.「おいおい また その写真か？\n そんなに見てると 穴があいちまうぞ。:
That photo again, huh?
Keep staring at it and you'll burn a
hole right through it!

346523.「ふふっ だって……うれしいんですもの。\n こうして あなたと 一緒になれて…:
Hee hee...I'm just so happy. That I can be
together with you like this and to have
everyone's blessing... It's like a dream.

346524.「ああ…… いい式だったよな。: The ceremony sure was beautiful, wasn't it?

346525.「オレとお前には この先\n そんなに長い時間は 残されていない。\n だが 乗:
The two of us don't have much time left...
But we'll still have plenty of tough things
to deal with along the way.

346526.「けどよ…… それが人生ってもんだ！\n 荒波を乗り越えた先に 輝くお宝が待って:
But you know...that's what life's all about! Beyond the rough seas waits a shining treasure...and I'm glad to have met a
treasure like you.

346527.「病めるときも 健やかなるときも……\n 死がふたりを別つまで 共にありましょう:
In sickness and in health, we'll be together
until death do us part...
Here, in these waters...

346536.「あなたは もしかして…… ムーロン様っ！\n 助けに きてくださったのですね！:
Are you, perhaps...Muron?!
Have you come to rescue me?!

346537.「メローラ…… すまねえな。\n オレが ここまで来たのは お前に\n 言わなく:
I'm sorry, Melora... I came all this way
because there's somethin' I need to tell
you.

346538.「オレとお前は もう会うわけにはいかねえ。\n 今日は それだけ 告げにきたんだ:
You and I...we can't see each other anymore.
That's all.

346540.「オレは お前のことを 大事に思ってる。\n その気持ちに 偽りはねえ……。\n:
I care about you. And that's the truth.
But...

346541.「この恋は お前を 不幸にしちまう。\n 親父さんも おふくろさんも お前に\n:
Our love'll only just make you unhappy.
Both your parents are against it only 'cause
they don't want to see you get hurt.

346542.「オレだって お前が みすみす\n 不幸せになるのなんか 見たくねえ。\n だか:
And I don't want to see you unhappy, either...
So that's why...I can't be a part of your life
anymore.

346545.「どうして…… どうして……\n 他でもない あなたが そんなことを言うの？\n:
Why...? How could you of all people say
such a horrible thing?

346547.「メローラの怒りに 海が共鳴しておる……！？\n 我が娘に これほどまでのチカラ:
The sea...it resonates with Melora's rage?!
To think my daughter would inherit such
power...

346548.「どうしてみんな 私の幸せを 勝手に決めるの？\n 生きる世界が違うことも 寿命:
Why does everyone else get to decide what makes me happy? The fact that we live in completely different worlds or that our
lifespans are different...of course I know all that!

346549.「でも どんなに苦しくても 共にいられる時間が\n 短くても 私には ムーロン様:
But no matter how painful it may be, no matter how short our time together is...you are the only one for me, Muron! You can't just
step all over my love!

346550.「いかん！ このままでは\n 海の世界が すべて 吹き飛ばされてしまう！\n メ:
This isn't good! The entire ocean realm will
be blown away at this rate, along with
Melora...

346551.「なんてこった……ちくしょう！\n オレは ホレた女を 不幸にすることしか\n:
Coufound it... Dang it all!
Is making the woman I love miserable
all I'm good for?!

346552.「そいつは オレが メローラに渡そうとしていた\n 指輪じゃないか！ 遠い昔に\:
That's that ring...the one I was supposed to
give to her! I could've sworn I buried it
at the beach a long time ago...

346553.「……覚悟を 決めろってことか。\n わかったよ。:
So you're telling me it's time to make up
my mind, eh... All right.

346554.「……メローラ メローラぁッ！\n 頼む 聞いてくれ……ッ！:
Melora! Hey, Melora!
Please listen to me!

346555.「オレは お前の幸せを願って 身を引いた！\n オレといることで お前に たくさ:
I only walked away because I wanted you to be
happy! I knew that if you stayed with me, all
you'd have was a broken heart...

346556.「オレも 正直 怖いし つれえよ……！\n だけどよ…… お前が 愛してくれるっ:
And the truth is...I'm terrified. This isn't easy for me, either... But, if you really say you love me...then I'm done lying to myself
about my feelings!

346557.「愛してるッ メローラ！\n お前の人生を オレにくれ！\n この海で死ぬまで:
I love you, Melora! Let's spend the rest of
our lives together! This sea will be our
home!

346559.「ずっと ずっと こうなりたかった。\n 私は あなたの伴侶として\n この先の:
This is all I've ever wanted.
I'll spend the rest of my life by your side...
as your beloved.

346560.「ああ…… お前は人魚 オレはウェディ。\n 別の種族のまま 一緒になるんだ。\:
Yeah...as mermaid and Weddie. We'll spend our days together without either of us changing who we are...and we'll face every sorrow and
every hardship side by side.

346561.「すべて 承知の上か……。\n そこまで 覚悟ができているのなら もはや\n 何:
So, you are fully aware of what this entails, yes? If this is truly what you wish, then there is nothing left for me to say. I entrust
my daughter's hand to you, dweller of land.

346562.「メローラ…… 私のかわいい娘よ。\n どうか 幸せにおなり。:
Melora, my sweet daughter...
May you always find happiness.

346563.「へへっ…… なんだか こそばゆいぜ。\n お前さんには ずいぶんと\n 世話に:
Heh, heh... Gotta say, I'm a bit embarrassed.
I really owe you for all your help in this.

346564.「さあ キュララナビーチへ 帰るとするか。\n 戻ったら お待ちかねの海開きだぞ:
Come on, let's head back to the beach!
Everyone's waiting for it to open!
